note: The style is a deformation of the body, not a different body. A 2005 character is a caricature: a bigger head than life, shoulders wider than life, a waist in, short thick legs, big hands and big boots, and everything in a heavy dark armour with a bright trim. The anatomy can be real and the shape can still be a drawing. This is the drawing, as numbers, applied to the body by tools/blender/proportion_pass.py.
how: for each vertex, the height t (0 at the feet, 1 at the crown) picks a band, and the band says how much wider or longer that part of the body is. The head is a separate lump: it is scaled about the neck, so the face keeps its shape and the head grows. The waist is the band that is pulled in, because the hourglass is what makes a character read as a drawing.

wardens.note: upright and clean: taller, narrower, the head a little smaller, the shoulders wide but flat

ashkin.note: the brute: a bigger head, a wider chest, shorter thicker legs, and arms that reach further
